title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today's biggest golf stories.

items.headline: Scheffler Leads FedEx St. Jude
items.text: Scottie Scheffler leads the FedEx St. Jude Championship at 13-under after three rounds at TPC Southwind, holding a two-shot edge over Sam Burns and Sungjae Im (-11).

items.headline: Bryson DeChambeau Dating Rumored
items.text: Bryson DeChambeau is reportedly dating former hockey goalie-turned-model Mikayla Demaiter amid a challenging season and a costly two-shot penalty at the Open.
